name: Boku no Yumemiru Mirai
original_name: ぼくのゆめみるみらい
source:
Goodnight, goodnight.
I hope to meet you again someday.

An unexpected tragedy took his wife. For half a year he mourned...
then she came back to him in a younger body!?
Reunited, his life is happy again.
But at the same time, something quietly draws near...

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE068350.html]DLsite English[/url]]
